Discover the amazing landscapes with coasts, rivers and national parks full of abundant flora and rare animal species.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Using her innate charm, Lay Lay convinces Sadie that she needs to come out of her shell and the best way for her to stand out is to run for student council.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Bibi live streams from the Chahuta reviewing the menu. However it doesn't deliver enough likes from her followers, so Twister steps up in disguise to help and is an instant hit. Bibi decides if they reach 1,000 followers she'll unmask him. Jade panics that the Marsupilamis will be exposed, and so Mica with the help of dessert, some flour, and a box does a swift swap with Twister before the grand reveal // A food critic books a table at the Chahuta, which sends Gran Gran into a panic. Mica tries to help Gran Gran make the Chahuta posher, while Jade is convinced that its uniqueness is what makes it special. Mica to stop them interfering locks Jade, Hope, and Punch outside with the Chahuta's regulars while the critic arrives. However, they manage to sneak back in, and switch the critic's meal for the daily special. Surprisingly the critic enjoys the unique atmosphere, the decor and food and awards the Chahuta five stars along with a glowing review.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Jade realizes being a good dancer in real life is very different to being a good dancer on a computer game. Hope shows her how it's done, meaning she tops a leader board and wins a visit from famous gamer Mr Best for a dance off in person. Jade tries to withdraw, but Mr Best calls her a chicken which makes her determined to beat him! Training with Hope begins, and Jade's ready for battle, but Mr Best doesn't play fair and ends up winning! Disappointed, Jade challenges Mr Best to a real dance battle which she wins. // Jade signs herself and Mica up to hopefully win the "Young Explorers" prize - a holiday for all their friends. Jade has suggested they put on a play that will be judged by Professor Lopez, but Mica has stage fright. The Marsups help with rehearsals, but when show day arrives the twins forget the script, and an essential prop. The Marsupilamis step up to save the day, and an awesome performance is delivered, that impresses Professor Lopez so much that he awards the school the prize.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Robbie and Tori go out for a meal but he forgets his wallet, so they have to stay behind in the restaurant and chop squid to pay for their food.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?"

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! programme.desc: Barbabravo, nagu salaagent, juhib vidinatega uurimist, et teada saada, kes röövis Barbapapa koogi. Barbalala on veendunud, et ta kuulis maja ümber suurt kana. Barbalapsed tulevad kokku, et valvata.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Treener Karima palub, et Rubble ja meeskond ehitaks aeroobikaetteasteks võimla. Kui poom on Lilyle liiga kõrge, siis kutsad peavad päeva päästma. Rändav etendus ei jõua Ehituslahte, seega Rubble ja meeskond otsustab oma etenduse luua.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Chargeril on probleem. Tal on magamiseks liiga palju energiat. Veab tal, et Rubble ja meeskonnal on alati ehituslahendus. Rubble ja kutsad ehitavad Mixile, Mootorile, Lucasele ja Lilyle lahedaima Super oravakeerise mängukohtingu eales.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: On Seiklustelahe vesternipäevad. Terve linn naudib üritusi, kui lehmade kari raudteejaamas rongilt põgeneb. Nüüd on kõik nagu vanas Metsikus Läänes ja Käpa-Patrull ajab linnas lehmi kokku. Yeehaw! // Kui Käpa-Patrulli sõber Alex otsustab, et ta tahab Käpa-Patrulli liikmeks saada, lubavad kutsad ja Ryder tal nendega kaasa sõita. Farmer Yumi talu kassi Cali päästmine muutub palju keerulisemaks, kui Alex aidata üritab.

programme.title: Hirvemeeskond
programme.desc: Meie kapjadega kangelased on tagasi ja seekord läheb Hirvemeeskond siit maailmast minema! Valmistu kangelaslikeks planeedijõu päästmisteks suurema jõu, lahedate uue tegelaste, imeliste vidinate ja esimest korda, erakordsete kosmose seiklustega!

programme.title: Переживу
programme.desc: Фильм начинается в грузинском Гори, родине Сталина. Владимир Котляров из панк-рок группы "Порнофильмы" сравнивает прошлые и нынешние режимы России. "Порнофильмы", основанные в 2010 году в Дубне, известны политизированными текстами и поддержкой оппозиции. С началом войны в Украине группа покинула Россию и отправилась в тур Stand with Ukraine с рэпером Face и группой "Нервы".

programme.title: Дело о Новом величии
programme.desc: 17-летняя Аня - обычный подросток, который обсуждает социальные и политические вопросы со своими друзьями в Интернете и мечтает о том, как улучшить жизнь в России. В марте 2018 года Аню и ее друзей внезапно арестовывают по обвинению в экстремизме. Молодым людям грозят годы тюрьмы. Мать Ани Юлия уже три года отчаянно борется за то, чтобы доказать невиновность дочери. Режиссёр Анна Шишова показывает безудержное политическое насилие в России и беспощадную расплату со свободной духом молодёжью в кадрах, снятых скрытой камерой.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.title: Сибириада
programme.desc: Посёлок Приисковый, находящийся в горах Хакасии, поражает своими контрастами. Здесь современные шале и отели соседствуют с полуразвалившимися лачугами и бараками местных жителей. Со всей страны в Приисковый приезжают любители катания на лыжах и сноубордах по пухляку - свежему, мягкому снегу. А уезжают из посёлка местные жители. Немногие из них хотят работать в туристическом бизнесе. Им сложно встроиться в новые условия. Раньше здесь работал золотоносный рудник. Но в девяностые его закрыли. Оставшиеся не у дел шахтёры ещё много лет нелегально добывали драгоценный металл в шахтах и горных реках.

programme.title: Дети снежного края
programme.desc: Из глухих высокогорных районов Гималаев Непала четырехлетних детей отправляют в школу Катманду под руководством буддийских монахов. Из-за отдаленности своих поселений они не общаются с родителями и близкими более 10 лет. Достигнув шестнадцатилетия, дети начинают путь обратно домой, но в это время Непал содрогают землетрясения. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Little Solange
programme.desc: Solange, age 13, sees her world disintegrate as her parents drift apart from one another. As the threat of divorce looms ever-closer, she worries but believes reconciliation is still possible. Deep down, the overly romantic teenager wants only one thing: that love should never end...

programme.title: Summer Hours
programme.desc: Two brothers and a sister witness the disappearance of their childhood memories when they must relinquish the family belongings to ensure their deceased mother's succession.

programme.title: Maestro(s)
programme.desc: Follow the relationship between a father and a son who are both music conductors.

programme.title: Horrid Henry: The Movie
programme.desc: Comedy based on the animated series about the fictional anti-hero, starring Angelica Huston, Richard E Grant, Parminder Nagra and Rebecca Front. When a group of corrupt school inspectors plan to close Henry's school, Ashton Primary, the headmaster of the neighbouring school sees his opportunity to make a fortune from the influx of new pupils, Henry puts together a talent contest, hoping that the success of his Zero Zombies Band will mean that no one will dare close Aston Primary. Miss Oddbot is not impressed and tells Henry that he should have thought about the future of the school before he started being horrid. Meanwhile, evil headmaster Van Winkle holds Miss Lovely, Perfect Peter and their friends hostage in his office. Thanks to Henry, Miss Oddbot realises what he is up to, and as the police arrive Henry is the hero - having managed to save the school he always claimed to hate?.

programme.title: Hunting and Gathering
programme.desc: The film opens showing the day-to-day life of an elderly lady named Paulette. Paulette lives alone, dedicated to her animals, in particular her cats, and her garden. Her worst fear is of dying far from her home and garden. However, when she takes a fall she is sent to hospital who then advise that she recovers in a nursing-home, much to her dismay.

programme.title: My First Time
programme.desc: Zachary is 20 years old. Dark and independent, he collects amorous conquests and school failure. Sarah is 18 years old. First class, fragile, she fills her emotional gaps with perfect control of his life. Nothing should close and yet, the year of the tank, for six months, they will live a love against which nothing can be, the true, the big one that marks a life forever.

programme.title: The Woodlanders
programme.desc: Producer-director Phil Agland made his fictional feature film debut in this Film4-funded adaptation of Thomas Hardy's classic novel. Emily Woof plays the daughter of a sawmill owner who loves woodsman Giles Winterbourne (Rufus Sewell), but is pushed into a "better" marriage to Dr FitzPiers (Cal Macaninch) with tragic consequences. Together with the narrative, Agland's sumptuous cinematic evocation of Hardy's Wessex captures the eye in a way few directors can.

programme.title: April And the Extraordinary World
programme.desc: April and the Extraordinary World is a 2015 French-Belgian-Canadian animated science fiction adventure film co-directed by Christian Desmares and Franck Ekinci. In 1870 on the eve of the Franco-Prussian War, French Emperor Napoleon III, accompanied by Marshal Bazaine, visits the lab of Gustave Franklin to access his project of breeding invulnerable supersoldiers. The emperor is disgusted with the results—two intelligent, talking komodo dragons ill-fit for war—and orders Bazaine to shoot them, but the creatures escape and the emperor instead causes an explosion that kills all three present. Napoleon III's successor then negotiates a settlement with Prussia to avert war, thus securing the throne to the House of Bonaparte.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: The Vanishing
programme.desc: Reda seemingly has a life of privilege in Algiers, in his late twenties still living at the family home, with a father who has arranged a job and a fiancée. Reda is eager to please, yet the more he tries the more he veers off course.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale
programme.desc: Drama set in 1960s New York about an Italian American boy surrounded by conflicting influences while growing up in the Bronx. The boy's father is almost powerless to do anything when his son becomes increasingly corrupted by a neighbourhood gangster. The two father figures - one hard-working and loving, the other involved in dangerous, underworld activities - exert conflicting pressures and beliefs.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: When Connor MacLeod is wounded in battle but does not die, he's exiled from his homeland as unnatural.

programme.title: The Transfiguration
programme.desc: When a troubled teenage boy who has a fascination with vampire lore meets an equally alienated girl, the two form a bond that begins to blend the boy's fantasies into reality.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans
programme.desc: Meet the Orangutans is a window into the extraordinary daily drama of the world's oldest Orangutan Sanctuary. From babies being bottle-fed and wearing nappies, to teenagers being taught how to climb trees, and wounded Orangutans arriving at the sanctuary needing urgent veterinary care, there is never a dull moment. The human carers, run by eccentric Brit Sue Sheward, are every bit as colourful too, and the jury's still out on who rules the roost - the staff or the apes.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Wild Appalachia
programme.desc: This stunning wildlife documentary captures the seldom seen wild side of America's most popular forests and reveals the nature of the Appalachians.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Winter has arrived at Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, and the time for preparation is over. It's almost Thanksgiving, and only 21 days remain until complete darkness overshadows the refuge - making it more important than ever to find food. With no supply of caribou left, Heimo crosses a newly frozen river to set up traps in a different territory. Bob recounts his recent harrowing experience of spending five days alone in the bush after he crashed his plane. Now, 400 miles from Fairbanks with little food, he hopes his two friends in town can recover the plane and get it back up and running quickly. With no more moose in sight, Ray sends his three daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, to find something for the family's Thanksgiving feast.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

The seafood spot is best known for its famous stuffed shrimp, but neither the signature dish nor the restaurant are what they used to be. Mavice's stubborn refusal to adapt is running the food, finances and family into the ground. Robert must convince Mavice to make the changes necessary to save her family's legacy and their livelihood.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible

Robert must get George to confront his painful past, open his heart and accept his wife's help in order to save their business and marriage.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible

It's up to Robert to unravel the truth behind this failing restaurant and help this family get back on track.

programme.title: Alaska Haunting
programme.desc: Jess and her boyfriend Dusty move into a remote log cabin in the woods in Point Mackenzie, Alaska. But, when strange things start to happen, they realize why the cabin was for sale. The couple has awakened a vengeful spirit and it wants them out.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: Featuring a fearless crew on a quest to hunt down chain-rattling ghosts and scary apparitions in anyway they can, Ghost Asylum follows a passionate paranormal team in America, the Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) as they attempt to "trap ghosts" in the country's most haunted abandoned asylums, mental hospitals and sanitariums. Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: Ghost Nation
programme.desc: Hair-rising American reality series that follows paranormal investigators Jason Hawes, Steve Gonsalves and Dave Tango, known from the ''Ghost Hunters'' television series, as they respond to calls from people who need their help with the cases of reportedly haunted locations around the United States. The guys are members of the paranormal investigation group- T.A.P.S., which Hawes founded, and they helped to create ''United Paranormal Research Organization (UPRO)'', which aims to be a global paranormal investigation organization that keeps local organizations connected. programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: ICE COLD GOLD spotlights a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before. The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.desc: Paranormal documentary and reality TV series follows investigations of scary locations reported to be haunted by ghost hunters Zak Bagans, Nick Groff, and Aaron Goodwin. Many places with shady past like hotels, casinos, homes, abandoned buildings are full of aggressive paranormal activities and do not let people live peacefully. Each episode begins with the crew touring the investigation site with its owners and interviewing the witnesses. Then the ghost hunters crew set up static night-vision cameras to film what's happening. They use a lot of up-to-date equipment to get any sort of evidence and then based on what they manage to get, they start analyzing and investigating things in order to get to the core of each case.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs
programme.desc: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid

Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

programme.desc: Baylen Out Loud follows the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with an extreme case of Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown?

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: The Australian Border Force investigates potential criminal activity on the tarmac. Emergency Planning Manager Riki oversees a multi-agency operation to repatriate 241 passengers arriving from Lebanon. Vision-impaired passenger Nina's assistance dog Nixon makes his final flight before he retires, Melbourne Cup runner up Warp Speed heads back to Japan.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A Bali-bound flight faces delays after a service truck crashes into its undercarriage. Australian Border Force find illegal weapons in a passenger's luggage. Unregistered taxi drivers are caught in the act and there's a fuel leak on the tarmac. At night, a mysterious Soviet-era plane lands unannounced.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto International Airport, multiple challenges push staff to their limits. An oversold flight needs passengers to surrender their seats, but will any volunteer? Cracked windows risk grounding a Dreamliner - they're still airworthy, but would anyone feel safe sitting beside them? And a rookie firefighter faces her biggest challenge, driving a state-of-the-art fire truck on a live airfield.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: At the California border, CBP searches a suspicious bulletproof truck and stops an SUV loaded with over $200,000 worth of concealed methamphetamine. Atlanta CBP Rovers hunt for smuggled cash, uncovering over $100,000 in counterfeit hundred dollar bills. And AMO executes Operation Blood Moon in the skies and waters around Puerto Rico. A high speed chase leads the agents to a seizure of nearly 2000 kilos of cocaine worth over $72 million.

programme.title: Akashinga: The Brave Ones
programme.desc: With many of Africa's key species, including elephants, heading toward extinction, Akashinga is a radical, new and highly effective weapon against poaching. Founded in Zimbabwe by former Australian special forces soldier and anti-poaching leader Damien Mander, the women-only team of rangers, drawn from the abused and marginalized, is revolutionizing the way animals are protected, communities are empowered — and its members' own lives are being transformed. Mander's innovative approach to conservation calls for community buy-in rather than full-on armed assault against poachers: If a community understands the economic benefits of preserving animals, then it will eliminate poaching without an armed struggle.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Ever slipped on ice and wondered why?….Ever been perplexed by your failure to throw a Frisbee….or spent sleepless nights trying to work out why your BMX jump ended up in a hospital visit? Well help is at hand as Richard Hammond returns for a second season of "Science of Stupid." This is the show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a second season. In this episode we learn just how many ways there are to embarrass, injure and humiliate oneself when rotating on a pommel horse, running through walls and jumping whilst wearing rollerblades.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry travels to Vietnam, a land of staggering natural beauty, ancient traditions and some of the fastest growing skylines on earth. Over 1,600 km from the vibrant South to the historic North, she uncovers the story of the country's remarkable post-war transformation. She immerses herself in the moped chaos in Ho Chi Minh City, helps with a muddy prawn harvest in the Mekong Delta and takes a restorative spa bath in the misty hilltops of Sapa. She ushers in the New Year with a local family celebrating the Tet festival and learns how a beloved dish, pho, tells a story of identity. In each place she visits, she meets characters whose lives have been shaped by both war and renewal. What emerges is a nation embracing change, where striking contrasts are balanced by a spirit of cooperation and strong family bonds.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry journeys across islands, mountains and olive groves to reveal why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. From sailing old trade routes through the Aegean to marvelling at the optical illusions hidden in the Parthenon, she explores how ideas were shaped by the dramatic landscape and how a mastery of maths, architecture and navigation fuelled a golden age of progress and innovation. Exploring the threads between ancient and modern Greece, she joins a family of olive farmers in Crete preserving centuries-old traditions, and visits the mountaintop monasteries in Meteora, where nuns safeguard classical texts. In the coastal town of Galaxidi, she's swept up in a riotous flour-throwing festival that blends ancient myth with modern identity.

programme.title: Break It Down
programme.desc: Yankee Stadium - home to the New York Yankees for over eight decades, and host to thirty-seven World Series - is about to be demolished. It's a mega job, with mega challenges. But the first task at hand is saving parts of the stadium. Everything from the seats…to the sod will be sold. When the memorabilia salvage is over, the teams get straight to work at clearing out the stadium of anything that's not part of structure. From kitchen equipment, to light bulbs, to the famous outfield frieze …it's all got to go. Then, the final breakdown. With an army of mega machines, the demo teams must systematically rip and strip-out the first two-tiers of seating until the stadium's nothing but a skeleton….then pull it down. But they're working within feet of a subway system that won't stop running. There's no room for error, and the job starts now.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: "Mega Marine Machines" brings viewers inside the most demanding marine operations on the planet, where powerful machines and skilled crews are pushed to their limits. Across oceans, rivers and working coastlines, each episode follows professionals using science, engineering and advanced technology to solve real-world problems on the water. With rare access to ships, shipyards and marine environments, the series reveals how critical decisions are made under pressure. As challenges unfold, the science behind the machines becomes clear, delivering meaningful insights through action-driven storytelling. The result is a forward-looking exploration of how humans are building, operating and innovating on the oceans and waterways of a changing world.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and recreated in astonishing detail from expert analysis and all the evidence. How did the nuclear reactor at 3 Mile Island meltdown? How did a small truck fire in the Mt Blanc road tunnel become a lethal inferno? How did the seven year old Sampoong department store in South Korea collapse onto hundreds of shoppers?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Florida experienced one of the deadliest structural failures in American history; India's dams are in distress after an avalanche of disasters; a partial collapse shuts down a Mallorca nightclub; and it's a race against time to save Italy's other leaning tower. We find out what happens when air gets into an airplane and how much huffing and puffing it actually takes to bring a brick house down.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: When a faraway earthquake brings a Bangkok skyscraper crashing down, investigators wonder why it was the only one to fail. Was a deadly wind whipped up by the tallest tower in Yorkshire? The destruction of a Danish landmark highlights the risks of historic renovation, a Bronx building collapse shows that any renovation is risky if not done according to plan, and working with mobile cranes reveals a long history of contemporary errors.

programme.title: Atlas of Cursed Places
programme.desc: The Bermuda Triangle. Everybody's heard about this stretch of cursed ocean off America's eastern coast where ships and aircraft disappear without explanation. Or do they? Sam dives in to the origin of the curse of the Bermuda Triangle and looks to oceanographers, physicists and probability analysts to get to the sandy wet bottom of this age-old ocean mystery.

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: For decades, the skies above the sprawling desert sands of Roswell, New Mexico have been home to thousands of reports of unidentified flying objects. But one particular home video has the Chasing UFO's team in hot-pursuit of the truth. Does the mysterious video in question really show an actual crash landing of an alien spacecraft? The team look into this and investigate the alleged 1947 crash site under the cover of darkness, and armed with night vision gear.

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: The saying, "Everything is bigger in Texas" proves to be true when Ryder, James, and Ben investigate reports of mysterious lights spotted in the skies over two Texas towns. The team begins tracking stories from over 30 witnesses who all share similar testimonies - seeing strange lights in the sky. Once they have gathered information, they head to a clearing where sightings were reported…and Ryder thinks she spots something mysterious in the sky! Eager to solve the mystery, they meet up with Pilot Steve Allen who demonstrates how it would be possible to mistake two airplanes flying in formation for one massive object.

programme.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough draws on a lifetime of experience to reveal Earth's most spectacular underwater habitats, showing that we're in the greatest age of Ocean discovery and highlighting its vital importance. While exposing the Ocean's biggest challenges, Attenborough's message is one of hope: the opportunity for marine life recovery on an unprecedented scale is within reach.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: With flames emerging through the cockpit floor, the pilots of Pilgrim Airlines 458 are desperate to land. Amid smoke, extreme heat and zero visibility, they somehow manage to touch down on a frozen Rhode Island reservoir. Within minutes, the inferno destroys any evidence of how the fire started. And with no data recorder, it's a surviving pilot who ultimatley gives investigators the break they need.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: "Mega Marine Machines" brings viewers inside the most demanding marine operations on the planet, where powerful machines and skilled crews are pushed to their limits. Across oceans, rivers and working coastlines, each episode follows professionals using science, engineering and advanced technology to solve real-world problems on the water. programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: A fire-scarred Great Lakes freighter completes its last journey to a family-run recycling yard on Lake Erie, where turning a dead ship into profit is anything but simple. At MRC's Port Colborne yard, the aging Cuyahoga must be stabilized, stripped and cut apart without contaminating the water or shoreline. Yard manager Jordan Elliott leads a crew working under constant pressure, where time is money and scrap prices can erase profits overnight. The operation hinges on high-risk moments: towing in a powerless ship, navigating brutal financial math, and executing the yard's signature move — using massive rubber airbags to haul the vessel out of the water. It's industrial recycling at full scale, offering a cleaner alternative to global shipbreaking while proving that modern methods can keep steel in circulation without poisoning the future.

programme.title: Time and Water
programme.desc: Facing the death of his country's glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason's archives become a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water.

programme.title: Oceanxplorers
programme.desc: The team is in the crystal-clear waters of Bimini in the Bahamas to witness the incredible journey of the great hammerhead shark. As the team follows their return migration to these warm waters in winter, they discover the secrets of how they navigate the vast ocean and how they use their incredible senses to exploit riches hidden in the shallows.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Journey from ancient China to Renaissance Europe and the plague stricken world of the 14th century. China's first emperor embraces a glittering elixir in hopes of eternal rule, unaware of the deadly legacy it will leave behind. A Renaissance scholar defies centuries of medical tradition, offering bold anatomical insights that redefine the limits of science. And as the black death ravages communities across continents, desperate physicians struggle to uncover what drives the mysterious killer. Through ambition, discovery and crisis, this episode highlights the dramatic turning points that reshaped humanity's understanding of life and death.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: In this opening episode, we recount the life of Chinggis Khan, beginning with the dramatic struggles of his early years, including his family's fall from power, his survival against rival tribes, and his first alliances as a young warrior determined to rescue his kidnapped wife, Borte.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: Temujin enlists a childhood friend called Jamuqa. Their close friendship eventually turns into rivalry. Temujin is defeated and is forced to spend 10 years with the Jin Empire. When he returns, Temujin reasserts his position on the Mongolian plains and has subjugated all who oppose him, including his former allies. Temujin takes the title by which he will forever be known: Chinggis Khan.

programme.title: Naming the Dead
programme.desc: Across the United States, more than 50,000 bodies remain unidentified—unmourned, unnamed, but not forgotten. "Naming The Dead", a riveting new six-part investigative series from National Geographic, brings these untold stories to light. The series follows the groundbreaking work of the DNA Doe Project, a trailblazing nonprofit that uses genetic genealogy to help law enforcement crack the country's most confounding cold cases.

Kuid raha hakkab napiks jääma ja nii peab Rocky alguses auto maha müüma ja siis Mickey poksikeskuses abijõuna töötma. Kohas, kus tema karjäär kunagi alguse sai, peab ta nüüd musti käterätte kokku korjama. Alles siis kui Apollo Creed teda argpüksiks nimetab, asub Rocky taas treenima, et oma au poksiringis taastada, seda vägagi oma raseda naise meelehärmiks. Lavastaja: Sylvester Stallone Osades: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Carl Weathers, Burgess Meredith, Tony Burton

programme.title: Kättemaks
programme.desc: Matt Turner on Berliinis elav edukas ameerika ärimees, kes tegeleb üheaegselt nii õitseva finantskarjääri kui ka perekohustustega. Ühel hommikul lapsi kooli sõidutades saab ta telefonikõne salapäraselt häälelt: ta istme all on pomm, mis ei plahvata vaid juhul, kui ta täidab teatud ülesannetejada, ja teeb seda kiiresti. Matt, kihutades suurel kiirusel läbi linna, peab järgima võõra üha ohtlikumaks muutuvaid juhendeid võidujooksus ajaga, et kaitsta oma peret ja lahendada müsteerium, mis ühe päeva jooksul lahti rullub.

programme.title: Krimi
programme.desc: Eesti staažikaim politseisaade toob vaatajateni olulisemad krimiuudised. Uudiseid elu pahupoolelt vahendab saatejuht Taavi Otsus.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Kristjan ja Teet jätkavad oma laevareisi Mekongi jõel, mis voolab läbi kuue Kagu-Aasia riigi. Laose loodus hämmastab oma metsiku iluga. Teel Luang Prabangi peatuvad kaks kanget Pakbengi külas. Elu on siin vaene, tänavad tolmused ja majad räämas, aga rahvas äärmiselt aus ja südamlik. Kristjan leebub ja ostab kohalikelt tervelt kolm õlasalli. Julgust jätkub enamakski. Ta istub kohalikega ühe laua taha ja sööb nendega ühest taldrikust vinnutatud pühvlinahka. Teekond viib edasi Luang Prabangi, turistide meelislinna Laoses. Kristjan saab kultuurišoki, kui peab osalema munkade toitmise tseremoonial. Teet ja Kristjan päästavad lahti neli puurilindu, et kahe kange tegemisi saadaks õnn ka edaspidi.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Kaks kanget jõuavad Kambodžasse. See on neljas ja ühtlasi viimane riik nende Kagu-Aasia rännakutel. Nad suunduvad otsejoones Kambodža kõige kuulsamasse ja maailma kõige suuremasse budistlikusse templisse Angkor Wati. Aastasadadeks hüljatud ja seejärel džunglisse uppunud templikompleks on pärast taasavastamist 19. sajandil lummanud miljoneid inimesi. Teet ja Kristjan sõidavad edasi Kambodža pealinna Phnom Penhi.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.desc: Sari jälgib pukseerimisettevõtteid, kes võistlevad Austraalia kõige karmimate ja tulusaimate lepingute nimel. Need pukseerimisseadmed on ehitatud vastu pidama planeedi kõige heitlikumatele ilmastikutingimustele, olles võimelised vedama tohutuid koormaid ning töötama ohtlikul ja ligipääsmatul maastikul.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad
programme.desc: Rasked ilmaolud teevad päästetöötajate elu raskeks. Lõunas pingutavad Thord ja tema kollanokast päästetöötaja Andrzej, et päästa poolakast autojuhi väärtuslik suhkrukoorem. Mehe autol pole libeda ajaks vajalikku varustust ja Thord teenib talle rattakette müües kenakese summa. Eidfjordis tuleb Bjornil mängida McGyverit. Tal tuleb auto radiaatorisse ilma lehtrita jahutusvett valama ja selleks tuleb midagi välja mõelda. Päris Põhjas annab vanameister Jo Roger vastutusekoorma oma poja Ole õlgadele.

programme.title: Vanavarahundid
programme.desc: UUS! Mike ja Frank on kogujad, kes reisivad mööda riiki ja läheksid kõikjale, et antiiki leida. Assistent Danielle'i abiga satuvad nad sageli naljakatesse olukordadesse.

programme.title: Sekundiga sajani 2.0
programme.desc: Doksari jälgib Eesti kõige kiirema inimese Andres Arnoveri, tema 3500-hobujõulise Ford Mustangi ja teenindava meeskonna teekonda kiirendusspordi EM-karusellis. Andres on sõitnud selle autoga veerandmiilil üle 400 km/h, mis tähendab 100 km/h saavutamist vähem kui sekundiga. See on karm katsumuste jada, kus väga suur roll on tiimil, ilmal, inimsuhetel ja tehnika vastupidavusel. See on ohtlik spordiala, sest sellisel kiirusel auto üle kontrolli kaotamine kujutaks tohutut ohtu. Sari näitab ära viiel etapil toimunu, mille käigus kogetakse nii suurt võidueufooriat kui ka keerulisi läbielamisi.

programme.title: Kalamehejutud
programme.desc: Saate Kalamehejutud peamiseks eesmärgiks on tutvustada erinevate kalaliikide püüdmiseks vajalikke vahendeid, nippe ja kalastuskohti. Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Marla ja ta äripartner Fran (Eiza González) kasutavad hästi välja töötatud pettust tõhusalt ka oma uusima ohvri peal, kelleks on pärijateta ja pereta rikas pensionär Jennifer Peterson (Dianne Wiest). programme.desc: Hooaja viimases osas õpib Evelin kõigele ja kõikidele "ei" ütlema, tema isa Sass aga õpib liiga kergesti "jah" ütlema. Vääramatu jõuna lükkavad need valikud isa ja tütart suure sõnnikuhunniku suunas. Majja ilmub tädi Viiu väidetav kasupoeg, kelle kiindumus Viiusse paneb Evelinil ohukellukese tilisema. Miks ei tohiks mitte kunagi orgasmi teeselda ja mida me saaksime ise teha, et suudaksime kogeda tõelisi naudinguid? Kui sa arvad, et oled seksi jaoks juba liiga vana, siis oota kuni kuuled 70 aastase Helgi lugu, kes hakkas seksi nautima alles 60 aastaselt.

programme.title: Mida vanemad sulle ei rääkinud

Igapäevane flirt, võrgutamine ja romantika ei kuulu vaid suhete loomise faasi, sel on ülitähtis osa ka paarisuhte sees. Stuudios vestleme teemale pühendunud Teelega ja Rauliga, kelle elus on võrgutamine olulisel kohal. Õpime üheskoos kuidas tulemuslikult flirtida ja milliseid saatuslikke vigu vältida. Mökö soovib sünnipäevakingituseks kassi ja Luru päeva lõbustuspargis. Algavad pöörased seiklused - poisid eksivad suures linnas ära, satuvad koomilistesse olukordadesse ja isegi presidendilossi. Vanemad panevad kõik mängu, et lapsed üles leida, ent see ei osutu lihtsaks. Film kuulus 2022. aasta Just Filmi lastefilmide võistlusprogrammi.

Saates käsitleme koos presidendi ja külalistega Kreutzwaldi raamatut "Eesti rahva ennemuistsed jutud". Stuudiokülalised on zooloog Aleksei Turovski, näitleja ja lavastaja Taavi Tõnisson ning Rahva Raamatu klubi.

programme.title: Kuidas elad
programme.desc: Aleksei Turovski räägib oma elust. Saatejuht Reet Linna. Toimetajad Marit Valk, Silvia Karro. Režissöör Priit Hummel.

programme.title: Eesti lood
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm viib vaataja Eesti metsadesse, laboritesse ja rahvapärimuse radadele. Me kohtume teadlaste Maria Vikantjeva ja Julia Gelleriga, kes avavad meile puukide salapärase maailma, ning inimestega, kelle elusid on puugid puudutanud - näitleja Ivo Uukkivi, kes kogus kampaania "Pane puuk posti" raames tuhandeid puuke, ja Sander Rebane, kes veetis haiglas nädalaid, võideldes puukentsefaliidi ja -borrelioosiga. Film uurib puukide elu ja teaduslikku tausta, kuid läheb kaugemale - see peegeldab meie enda olemust. Kas inimene pole looduse "puuk" - olend, kes võtab aina rohkem, andmata midagi vastu? Režissöör Madis Ligema loob poeetilise ja mõtlemapaneva vaatluse looduse tasakaalu ja inimese rolli üle selles hapras süsteemis. Tootja Davai Laama.

programme.title: Teemaõhtu
programme.desc: 2015. aasta Hommik Anuga saates oli külaliseks Aleksei Turovski.

programme.title: Katkenud elu
programme.desc: R: James Mangold. O: Winona Ryder, Angelina Jolie. Oscariga pärjatud tõsieluline draama räägib 19-aastase neiu läbielamistest psühhiaatriahaiglas 1960. aastate Ameerikas. Susanna (Ryder) on suitsiidsusele kalduv ebastabiilne noor naine, kes pannakse ravile Claymoore'i psühhiaatriahaiglasse. Seal sõbruneb ta teiste patsientidega, sealhulgas mässumeelse Lisaga (Jolie), kes teeb Susannale ettepaneku koos haiglast põgeneda, et näha elu teispool "vanglamüüre". Kuid elul on põgenike jaoks teised plaanid. Filmi aluseks on Susanna Kayseni autobiograafilised memuaarid. Linateose lavastajaks on James Mangold ("Logan", "Indiaani Jones ja saatuse seier"). Peaosades parima kõrvalosatäitja Oscari ja Kuldgloobuse pälvinud Angelina Jolie ("Vahetus", "Pahatar") ja mitmekordne Oscari-nominent Winona Ryder ("Süütuse aeg", "Mardikamahl, mardikamahl").

programme.title: Voodist voodisse
programme.desc: Järjekordses maailmas tõdeb Mae, et selle elu Gina ei mäleta midagi eelmisest. Mae ainus võimalus saada oma küsimustele vastused, on jälitada munk Dawat. Vestlus mungaga toob Mae tõekspidamistesse tähtsa pöörde.

programme.title: Armas Inglismaa
programme.desc: Pärast läbimurret MM-finaalturniiril on taastunud usk ja Inglismaa rahvuskoondis naaseb koju, valmis alustama uut peatükki. Ootamatu olukord toob EM-finaalturniiri neile koju kätte. Kas Southgate'i meeskond suudab ajalugu ümber kirjutada ja võidu koju tuua?

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Vabastatud Django
programme.desc: Vabastatud mustanahaline ori päästab Saksa lunarahaküti abiga oma naise jõhkra plantaatori käest.

programme.title: Langus
programme.desc: Mägironimismatkal juhtub õnnetus ning parimad sõbrannad Becky ja Hunter jäävad lõksu 600 meetri kõrguse teletorni tippu.

programme.title: Uus tütar
programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.

programme.title: Keelatud kuningriik
programme.desc: Kung-fu'd fänniv noormees satub salapärasel kombel iidsesse Hiinasse, kus talle saab osaks päästa vangistusest legendaarne Pärdik-kuningas.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Hoogne põnevusfilm seiklejast Dirk Pitt'ist (Matthew McConaughey), kes satub Lääne-Aafrika kõige ohtlikumas piirkonnas elu suurimasse seiklusesse. Ta peab leidma Surmalaevaks ristitud vana sõjalaeva. Kui selgub, et otsitav laev võib olla seotud kohalike salapäraste surmajuhtumitega, tuleb Dirkil, tema teravmeelitseval sõbral Alil (Steve Zahn) ja dr Eva Rojasel (Penelope Cruz) jääda ellu ohtlikes tingimustes, lahenda müstilised saladused ning kavaldada üle ohtlikud sõjapealikud ja kahtlased agendid.

programme.title: Langus
programme.desc: Mägironimismatkal juhtub õnnetus ning parimad sõbrannad Becky ja Hunter jäävad lõksu 600 meetri kõrguse teletorni tippu.

programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.
